#{This algorithm adaptively penalizes maximum-utility tour edges by scaling the penalty factor dynamically using the coefficient of variation and outlier deviation of tour edge lengths to aggressively dismantle long structural edges.}#

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Standard Voudouris & Tsang utility metric
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    
    # Tour edge statistics
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    std_edge = np.std(tour_lengths)
    cv = std_edge / (avg_edge + 1e-12)
    
    # Adaptive penalty scaling based on edge dispersion to break outlier long edges
    adaptive_factor = 0.25 + 0.25 * np.clip(cv, 0.0, 2.0)
    base_penalty = adaptive_factor * avg_edge
    
    # Select edges with near-maximum utility
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_lengths = tour_lengths[selected_mask]
    
    # Modulate edge penalty by relative edge length to penalize prominent bottlenecks
    length_weight = np.maximum(1.0, sel_lengths / (avg_edge + 1e-12))
    penalties = base_penalty * length_weight
    
    # Apply symmetric updates
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalties
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalties
    
    return updated_edge_distance
